text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Jordan's Prime Minister Abdul-Salam al-Majali calls for better ties with Kuwait which says Amman sided with Iraq during its 1990-91 occupation of the Gulf Arab state.
- Union of Arab Stock Exhanges to discuss cross-listing of shares on the Kuwait, Lebanon and Egypt bourses. The Union is due to hold its annual meeting in Cairo on June 15.
- Minister of Social Affairs and Labour Ahmad al-Kulaib will head Kuwait's team to the annual International Labour Conference which opens in Geneva on Tuesday.
- Two gunmen rob a Kuwait City jewellery store.
- Government proposes broadcasting parliamentary sessions on the state radio.
- Ambassadors of Benin, Singapore and South Africa present credentials to Foreign Minister Sheikh Sabah al-Ahmad al-Sabah.
- Emir Sheikh Jaber al-Ahmad al-Sabah attends the graduation ceremony of 101 police officers.
